title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime!

meta.Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The books may not show it now, but in a few years time, this park may begin falling into the red.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And that's why they decided to partner with Riley Entertainment?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Their intellectual property, particularly their characters, are popular among younger generations and would serve to attract this demographic to the park.

rows.Line: Yes, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Line: The story itself is very straightforward, but the classics are the ones that really tug at your heartstrings! Guests of all ages will surely be able to enjoy this one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It really does involve every single ride and attraction...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this plan might actually work. I'm sure everyone's gonna love it...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:

I'd like to try it...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But won't you need a much larger cast than normal to make this happen...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, so what should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Line: We'll just have to include every troupe from every stage, including all the staff, in Phoenix Wonderland...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show is all about making everyone remember just what kind of park Phoenix Wonderland is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By including every troupe and all the staff, we'll be able to put on a performance unlike any other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... You think they'll be willing to help us? I mean, they're all working and doing their own shows...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that convincing them to help us will be quite a challenge. Admittedly, this show is a little out there as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

One that no one's ever experienced...
One filled with dreams and wonderment!!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But there is one more thing I'd like to do alongside all that. We'll need to have much more people than normal see this show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Show Contest itself will already attract quite a few guests, but only to the degree that the operators have predicted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right... That means we have to do a little more in order to get more people to see this show.

How did you know...?!

rows.Line: I happened to overhear your conversation while you were asking one of the other troupes to help.

rows.Line: What? You were eavesdropping?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: What?! No, I was there by pure coincidence...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyways, I cannot let this pass without interjecting first myself...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This Show Contest is being held to attract more guests to this park. Why in the world are you trying to ruin that by essentially biting the hand that's feeding you?

rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Line: We know that what we're trying to do might not actually be possible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we understand that it'll probably be a lot easier to get more people to come to the park if a big company from overseas helps us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...!
That'll make everyone that loves and cherishes Phoenix Wonderland really, really sad...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland isn't just a place for young people. It needs to be a place that can make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I want lots and lots of people to come here, and make it so they can all smile and laugh together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how impossible it might sound. If there's still a way to make both of those things happen, I'm gonna try it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So please! I beg you!
Help us do this show!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You really think I'll agree to something like this just because you're wearing your heart on your sleeve...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You're in the running to win this contest too, no? Are you sure about letting that chance just slip by?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hnng...

rows.Line: However, I would be lying if I said that I don't mind not winning despite how much work we put into it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He worked so hard for this contest. Maybe I should...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll just have to find another opportunity...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Truth be told, winning this contest was my goal. If this problem didn't rear its ugly head, I would be doing everything I can to win right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we have something much more important to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to save the Phoenix Wonderland that made so many people smile and laugh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As cast members of this park, we must always make sure that never goes away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To hell with this contest! There's something much greater at stake right now! We need to act!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin, this same feeling must dwell somewhere within that heart of yours! There is a part of you that knows this!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'd rather not be lumped together with someone as obnoxious as you are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-What?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, I do understand where you're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: If it's my aid you seek, then you must present me a detailed plan first...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Regardless of my ultimate decision, that will be our first step.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll listen to our plan?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Three cheers for Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To start, we'll need you to read this. We can further discuss any details after that.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Wait, you're serious about this...?

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: It'd be amazing to actually pull this off but...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (They actually plan on doing this show...?!)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (I've never heard of any other parks doing anything like this. If we do somehow pull this off, it's sure to go viral, but this is beyond just challenging...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (Yet... I can't get rid of this tingling sensation...)

rows.Speaker: Rui

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're rather proud of this plan so...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Please!
Help us put on this show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please, join us. If you do, this show will definitely have a much greater chance at succeeding.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Help us, Seiryuin.
You're our only hope!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I've been coming to this park since I was a little girl...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This was where I learned for the first time that places as fun and wonderful as this existed.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: All the singing and dancing felt like it came straight out of a movie. It was so beautiful to see, and I wanted to be a part of that...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The Rainbow Stage was a particular favorite of mine. So much so that I was talking to members of its troupe on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Rainbow Stage...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's an old stage that used to be in this park. I really, really loved it too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it was one of the first things to go...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: How this park is run began to gradually change so that it would appeal more to young people, and it's been bothering me for so long...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But I was in no position to say anything since the Phoenix Stage was benefiting from those changes.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Then I realized something. I looked out into the audience one day and noticed that there were almost no children or elderly guests.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It suddenly felt like that little girl from my memories would no longer be welcome here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: As a business, this park may very well be headed in the right direction. Phoenix Wonderland should be able to stay open if more young people come and visit.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But this used to be a place for everyone. At the very least, I loved what this park used to be.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I want to see that Phoenix Wonderland again. I want this park to be “a place that makes everyone smile.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You'll help us?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I will.
However, what the other members of my troupe wish to do is entirely up to them.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: So, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: To be honest, it was sad seeing all of our usual guests not show up little by little...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought that was just how things were gonna be from now on, but maybe we still have time to turn that around...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: If you're in, Sakurako, then I'll help too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Th-This is super duper wonderhoy!!
Thank you so much, Sakurako♪

rows.Line:
Uh, yes... Of course...
We're on a first name basis now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! Now that we have you, we can start gathering more cast members!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes... But let's go talk to the troupes that already once turned you down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm generally aware of what's going on with the other troupes. The members of my troupe often exchange information amongst themselves.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: By changing your angle, you may actually be able to convince them into joining you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And once they hear that the Phoenix Stage has joined our side, I'm sure they'll be more willing to hear us out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...!
That's great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to help us, Seiryuin. Let's make this happen...!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Of course, Tenma.
Let's make this show one for the ages.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry to bother you again!
Please, would you mind giving us just one more chance?!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
You again...?
Sorry but we're not...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hello. Do you have some time to talk?

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: What? Seiryuin...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, you were the one that fought the hardest against the removal of the Rainbow Stage...

rows.Line: W-What do you want...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: First, we'd like to express our gratitude. Thank you for putting on such a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I'd convinced myself that dreams and ideals were too frivolous to be bothered with...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you proved me wrong. I realize how great it is to be able to believe in something now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Which is why there's something we'd like you to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Something you want us to do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just what exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We want you to become ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ambassadors...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Your show has turned Wonderlands×Showtime into an overnight sensation. This new position is designed to make full use of that fame.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'd like you to keep putting on shows like the one we saw yesterday, as well as at the Wonder Stage, while also performing at venues outside of Phoenix Wonderland as its representatives.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: The original plan was to have the winners of the Show Contest appear in a new commercial for the park, but that's all been washed aside now...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Instead, we'll be having you perform new shows and advertise for this park.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that means...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is our chance to have the entire country see our incredible shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we accept your offer!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold your horses. Shouldn't we hear more details first before we dive in like that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, I'm sure we'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, you'll have our full support as well. Outwardly, it's for the sake of this park...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you reminded us of what Phoenix Wonderland is capable of and we want you to help us reach that potential. We promise not to disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, it's as Keisuke said.
We're looking forward to seeing more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we call this the end of act one and the beginning of act two...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everything ended on a high note, but it also means we still have plenty of work left to do, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright then!
Wonderlands×Showtime, on me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guh! I didn't say you could tackle me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now...
We, Wonderlands×Showtime, will be beginning our new journey as ambassadors for this park!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As we embark upon this new endeavor, we will very likely also be faced with new hurdles that we must conquer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But our goal will remain the same!
We'll be bringing joy to everyone with our shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take on these challenges and make our dream a reality!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So then, Emu, will you do the honors...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What honors?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Oh, you wanna join in too, Keisuke, Shosuke? When I say this you'll...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What? There's no way I'm doing that!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. Sure, I'll bite...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You will?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, here we go...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, Rui & Keisuke
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! Why didn't you say it, Shosuke?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Are you serious?! Why would I do something like that?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
This reminds me of when we were kids, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So begins the act two of Wonderlands×Showtime's magnificent spectacle!!
